subject: general
question: How much amount did the Board of Control for Cricket in India Secretary Jay Shah provide to the Indian Olympic Association (IOA) as a support for the Indian contingent for Paris Olympics 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**8.5 crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Jay Shah, the Secretary of the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI), announced a financial support of **8.5 crore** to the Indian Olympic Association (IOA).
 
• This support is aimed at assisting the Indian contingent participating in the **Paris Olympics 2024**.
 
• The financial contribution underscores the commitment of BCCI to promote sports beyond cricket and support Indian athletes.
 
• This initiative is part of BCCI's broader vision to foster a multi-sport culture in India.
 
• The funds will be utilized for training, preparation, and other logistical support for the Indian athletes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Paris Olympics 2024**

 
 
• The 2024 Summer Olympics, officially known as the Games of the XXXIII Olympiad, will be held in Paris, France.
 
• Paris has previously hosted the Olympics in 1900 and 1924.
 
• The event is scheduled to take place from July 26 to August 11, 2024.
 
• Approximately 10,500 athletes from 206 National Olympic Committees are expected to participate.
 
• The games will feature 329 events in 32 sports.
 
 
 
• **Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI)**
 
 
• BCCI is the national governing body for cricket in India.
 
• Founded in 1928, it is one of the richest and most powerful cricket boards in the world.
 
• The board is responsible for organizing domestic and international cricket matches in India.
 
• BCCI also oversees the Indian Premier League (IPL), one of the most lucrative T20 leagues globally.
 
 
 
• **Indian Olympic Association (IOA)**
 
 
• IOA is the governing body for the Olympic Movement and the Commonwealth Games in India.
 
• Established in 1927, it ensures the representation of Indian athletes in international competitions like the Olympics.
 
• IOA is affiliated with the International Olympic Committee (IOC).
 
• It is responsible for the preparation and training of Indian athletes for the Olympics, Asian Games, and Commonwealth Games.
 
 
 
• **Support for Indian Athletes**
 
 
• Financial support is crucial for the training and development of athletes.
 
• Such contributions help in providing world-class facilities and coaching.
 
• It also covers travel, accommodation, and other expenses related to international competitions.
 
• Supporting athletes boosts their morale and performance, leading to better outcomes in global events.
